# Popover in the bootstrap look

Its parts, props and data attributes: [Popover](https://menhir-ui.com/docs/components/popover.md).

## PopoverExample.tsx

```tsx
import { Popover } from "menhir/popover";

import button from "../../../looks/bootstrap/button.module.css";
import styles from "./popover.module.css";

export default function PopoverExample() {
  return (
    <Popover.Root>
      <Popover.Trigger class={[button.button, button.secondary]}>
        Notifications
      </Popover.Trigger>
      <Popover.Popup sideOffset={8} class={styles.popup}>
        <Popover.Arrow class={styles.arrow} />
        <Popover.Title class={styles.title}>Notifications</Popover.Title>
        <div class={styles.body}>
          <Popover.Description class={styles.description}>
            You are all caught up.
          </Popover.Description>
          <div class={styles.actions}>
            <Popover.Close
              class={[button.button, button.outline, button.small]}
            >
              Close
            </Popover.Close>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Popover.Popup>
    </Popover.Root>
  );
}
```

## popover.module.css

```css
/* Bootstrap's popover: a small card with a grey header, a body and an arrow
   that points at the trigger. Menhir places the Popup and writes data-side;
   the arrow sits on the edge that faces the trigger. The browser's own
   popover styles scroll its overflow, which would clip the arrow. The Popup
   is hidden while closed, so it takes no display of its own. */
.popup {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 276px;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 2 * var(--spacer-2));
  padding: 0;
  overflow: visible;
  border: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
  border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius-lg);
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  background-clip: padding-box;
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  box-shadow: var(--bs-box-shadow);
  transition: opacity 0.15s linear;
}

.popup:focus-visible {
  outline: 0;
}

/* Exit: Menhir keeps the Popup shown until this transition ends. */
.popup[data-closed] {
  opacity: 0;
}

/* Entry: where the Popup starts from when it opens. */
@starting-style {
  .popup[data-open] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* A square turned 45 degrees, half of it outside the Popup's edge, with the
   Popup's border on the two sides that show. */
.arrow {
  position: absolute;
  width: 0.75rem;
  height: 0.75rem;
  rotate: 45deg;
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
}

/* Below the trigger the arrow meets the header, and takes its colour. */
.arrow[data-side="bottom"] {
  top: calc(-0.375rem - var(--bs-border-width));
  border-top: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
  border-left: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
  background-color: var(--bs-secondary-bg);
}

.arrow[data-side="top"] {
  bottom: calc(-0.375rem - var(--bs-border-width));
  border-right: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
  border-bottom: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
}

.arrow[data-side="right"] {
  left: calc(-0.375rem - var(--bs-border-width));
  border-bottom: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
  border-left: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
}

.arrow[data-side="left"] {
  right: calc(-0.375rem - var(--bs-border-width));
  border-top: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
  border-right: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
}

/* Above the arrow, which would otherwise show through it. */
.title {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0;
  padding: var(--spacer-2) var(--spacer-3);
  border-bottom: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
  border-radius: calc(var(--bs-border-radius-lg) - var(--bs-border-width))
    calc(var(--bs-border-radius-lg) - var(--bs-border-width)) 0 0;
  background-color: var(--bs-secondary-bg);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.body {
  padding: var(--spacer-3);
}

.description {
  margin: 0;
}

.actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  margin-top: var(--spacer-3);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .popup {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```
